evidence.description: Manufacturer datasheet; values transcribed from the material table and the 'Relative core losses PV (typical values)' table. Typical values measured by TDK on R34 toroids; not AIPE measurements.
evidence.locator: material table p.1-2; PV typical values table

evidence.reference: Least-squares Steinmetz fit of the four TDK N87 datasheet loss points at 100 degC (aipe-magnetics 0.2.0)
evidence.description: log(Pv) = log(k) + alpha log(f) + beta log(B) fitted to (25 kHz, 200 mT, 57 kW/m3), (100 kHz, 200 mT, 375 kW/m3), (300 kHz, 100 mT, 390 kW/m3), (500 kHz, 50 mT, 215 kW/m3); residuals +1.0 %, -3.2 %, +4.7 %, -2.3 %. Derived data, valid only as a 100 degC interpolation over 25-500 kHz and 50-200 mT.

evidence.reference: J. Muhlethaler, J. Biela, J. W. Kolar, A. Ecklebe, 'Improved core-loss calculation for magnetic components employed in power electronic systems', IEEE Trans. Power Electron., vol. 27, no. 2, pp. 964-973, Feb. 2012, doi:10.1109/TPEL.2011.2162252
evidence.description: Table I: iGSE parameters of EPCOS N87 (R42 toroid, 25 degC, symmetric triangular flux) fitted on three operating points (dB 0.1 T at 20 kHz, 0.1 T at 50 kHz, 0.2 T at 50 kHz; dB peak-to-peak): k_i = 8.41, alpha = 1.09, beta = 2.16 (SI: W/m3, Hz, T). Sec. IX reports triangular-waveform measurements over 20-100 kHz, which is wider than the fit span. Converted to the classical k by the exact k_i relation for storage.
evidence.locator: Table I, p. 970; Sec. IX validity
